attendance_instruction.title: Policy & Instruction
attendance_instruction.instruction_1: 1. Take 1 live selfie (front camera) with full face visible.
attendance_instruction.instruction_2: 2. Take 1 live environment photo (back camera) showing actual work location/activity (e.g. event setup location)
attendance_instruction.instruction_3: 3. Internet and GPS must be enabled; fake GPS and gallery uploads are not allowed and will be detected.
attendance_instruction.instruction_4: 4. Photos must be clear and reflect real work activity.
attendance_instruction.instruction_5: 5. Mobile attendance is restricted to authorized employees only. Unauthorized use is prohibited.
attendance_instruction.instruction_6: 6. Any incorrect or suspicious attendance will be verified by the HR Team and may lead to disciplinary action.
attendance_instruction.disclaimer_checkbox: I confirm that this attendance submission is true and accurate and reflects my actual work activity.
